TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Modifies a pricing rule that is being used for payments on EVA platform
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. The transaction reads pricingRuleId and pricingRuleRequest, obtains auditUserId from RequestHeaderParamsName.USERCODE, and calls ABKOR001.executePutPricingRules(pricingRuleId, pricingRuleRequest, auditUserId). 2. executePutPricingRules loads the current pricing rule and its active details; if existing is null, it adds advice ABKO10000405 with the missing-rule description and returns null. It then validates the requested update: if actual.getActive() is false it throws ABKO10000407; if the current status is not PAA, PAU, REJ, SYE or SYC it throws ABKO10000408; if status is SYC and hasActiveChildren is true it throws ABKO10000417; if validateActivationDate(pricingRule.getEffectiveDate()) is false it throws ABKO10000413; if the rule requires a restricted update and forbidden main-field, fee-type or non-SET detail changes are detected it throws ABKO10000414. Next it validates duplicates: if pricingRuleType is not V, R or P it throws ABKO10000416; if a candidate rule matches the required detail configuration it throws ABKO10010401; if a variable rule overlaps in payment method with an existing candidate it throws ABKO10010415. 3. The library fills optional comments, precedenceType and progressiveType from the existing rule when they are absent, resolves each detail value with fillDetailValues, and throws ABKO10010004 when a detail query is missing, returns an empty value, or raises NoResultException. It then either creates a new synchronized version with handleSycUpdate when the existing status is SYC or syncs details and updates the current rule with status PAU otherwise. 4. Any PricingRuleException is converted to advice with addAdviceWithDescription(e.getCode(), e.getDescription()); ABKO00000010 is produced when deactivateDetail gets updateResult == 0 or when updatePricingRule gets result == 0; after the library call, assignSeverityError sets Severity.EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. The transaction assigns the library result to pricingRuleResponse through setPricingruleresponse; on success, the response returns the modified pricing rule with resolved detail values and status PAU.
